name: Seltorexant
sort_evidence: Seltorexant, J&J's orexin-2 receptor antagonist, is in Phase 3 for MDD (NCT07573176 and NCT06559306, recruiting) with no FDA or EMA authorisation in the local approvals or EMA tables.

trials.title: A Study of Seltorexant as Monotherapy in Adults and Elderly Participants With Major Depressive Disorder
Phase 3 Study of Adjunctive Treatment With Seltorexant in Adult and Elderly Participants With Major Depressive Disorder and Insomnia Symptom
